rules.notes: ai-primary docs with a compact reviewer pack; markdown limited to constraints and short references

work items with a lifecycle. Every spec lives in a bucket and declares a matching status (proposed|active|shipped|superseded); enforced by npm run lint:structure. Each spec should include intent fields (purpose/design_intent/change_impact) with concise semantics
behavior contracts, policies, rulesets. Current truth, never 'done' — no status field. Loaded at runtime by config/runtime-validation.ts and lib/observer/policyLoader.ts
reviewer pack: API/route catalogs, screen inventories, design guidelines, risk registers. Current truth — no status field
